rows.name: 3-SAT (reference survivor)
rows.citation: POC: 3-SAT on ibm_kingston (51.9% vs 6.2% floor); SETH-hard
rows.best_classical_source: SETH (Impagliazzo–Paturi): no 2^{cn}, c<1 for k-SAT as k→∞
rows.notes: the cleanest point above the √2 line; already on hardware

rows.name: Betweenness
rows.citation: Opatrný, 'Total Ordering Problem', SIAM J. Comput. 8(1):111–114, 1979
rows.hardness_assumption: none — a 2^n·poly subset DP over the placed set exists
rows.best_classical_source: subset DP over the placed prefix (2^n·poly)
rows.notes: ordering (n!); collapses via 2^n placed-prefix DP (was predicted SURVIVES in the draft)

rows.name: Numerical Matching with Target Sums
rows.citation: Garey & Johnson, Computers and Intractability, 1979 [SP17] (strongly NP-complete; no 1978 journal primary confirmed — cite the book)
rows.hardness_assumption: none — best known is an O(2^n·n) bitmask assignment DP
rows.notes: assignment (n!); target penalty (Σ s·x − B)² reuses the number-partitioning form

rows.name: Quadratic Congruences
rows.citation: Manders & Adleman, 'NP-Complete Decision Problems for Binary Quadratics', J. Comput. Syst. Sci. 16(2):168–184, 1978
rows.best_classical_source: factor b → Tonelli–Shanks per prime power → CRT (sub-exponential)
rows.notes: the real quantum win is Shor (factoring), not Grover; c ≪ 0.5, algebraic collapse

rows.name: Kernel of a Digraph
rows.citation: Chvátal, tech report CRM-300, Univ. de Montréal, 1973 (technical report, not a journal); see also Fraenkel, Discrete Appl. Math. 3:257–262, 1981
rows.hardness_assumption: measured — branch-and-reduce exact exponent vs the √2 line
rows.notes: the star / borderline: independence pulls c→0.288, domination pulls c→0.598; measured c decides

rows.name: Minimum Linear Arrangement
rows.citation: Garey, Johnson, Stockmeyer, 'Some Simplified NP-Complete Graph Problems', Theoret. Comput. Sci. 1(3):237–267, 1976
rows.hardness_assumption: none — best known is the O*(2^n) Bellman–Held–Karp DP
rows.notes: ordering (n!); total cost = Σ prefix cuts ⇒ 2^n cut DP collapses it
